signature-maker: Choose Draw it and sign with your finger or mouse, or choose Type it and enter your name in a handwriting style.
Choose black, blue, dark red or green, and the pen thickness. Undo or clear and try again until you like it.
The preview shows your signature trimmed to the ink on a checkered see-through background.
Download the PNG, with a see-through or white background, and add it to a form, document or the Sign PDF tool.
sign-pdf: Choose the PDF you need to sign. It opens in your browser and is never uploaded.
Draw or type a signature, or use a picture of your signature. A signature on white paper can be made see-through.
Pick the page and tap on the preview where the signature should sit. Change the size with the slider.
Choose this page, the last page or every page, then download the signed PDF.
document-scanner: Take a photo of each page with your camera, or choose pictures from your gallery. Add more at any time.
Pick Clean colour, Clean gray or Black and white, turn the page, and trim the edges with the sliders.
Move pages earlier or later and remove any that you do not need.
Choose A4 pages or the picture size and download one PDF, or save a single page as a picture.
passport-photo-sheet-maker: Choose a clear, straight-on photo with a plain background and even light.
Pick 35 x 45 mm, 2 x 2 inch, 30 x 40 mm, 25 x 35 mm or your own size, then zoom and move the photo inside the frame.
Pick 4 x 6 inch, 5 x 7 inch or A4 paper and how many copies. The sheet preview shows the layout and cut lines.
Download the PDF and print it at 100% (actual size), then cut along the thin lines.
photo-grid-splitter: Choose the picture you want to spread across the grid.
Pick up to 5 columns and 5 rows, and choose square, portrait or keep-the-picture-shape pieces.
Zoom and move the picture until the part you want sits across the grid. The preview shows the lines and post order.
Download all pieces as one zip. Post them from number 1 to the highest number.
photo-collage-maker: Choose between two and nine photos. Move them earlier or later to change the order.
Pick an even grid or one big photo, and a size for a square post, a story, or A4 portrait or landscape.
Set the space between photos, rounded corners and the background colour. The preview updates as you go.
Download the collage as a JPG for sharing or a PNG for the best quality.
secret-santa-generator: Type each person on a new line. You need at least three different names.
Optionally add pairs who must not draw each other, such as a couple, and a gift budget.
Press Draw the names. The draw happens on your phone and nobody sees the result yet.
Each person taps their own name, sees who they got, then hides it. Each name opens only once.
stamp-maker: Choose a round seal with curved text or a rectangle with straight lines.
Enter the top and bottom text and up to three middle lines, such as the name, place or PAID.
Pick the ink colour, double border, stars, tilt and how worn the ink looks.
Download the PNG with a see-through background and place it on your document.
id-card-maker-printable: Type the school or business name and add a logo or picture. It prints in the coloured band at the top of every card.
Type one person per line as Name | Class or role | ID number, or leave it empty for blank cards to fill in by hand.
Pick a colour band or side stripe, a theme colour and font, and whether to print a photo box and a signature line.
Download the PDF, print on card or thick paper at actual size, stick in photos and cut along the card edges.
upi-payment-qr-stand-printable: Add your shop name and logo
Type your shop name and add a logo. They print in the band at the top of the sign.
Type your UPI ID and the name you want people to see when they pay. Optionally add a fixed amount.
Scan the QR code on the preview with your own UPI app and confirm that the name and ID are right.
Download the PDF, print it, and put it in a stand or frame near the counter.
wifi-password-sign-printable: Optionally add your cafe, office or home name and a logo to print at the top.
Type the network name and the password, or choose Open if there is no password.
Decide whether to print the password in words. The QR code lets phones join without typing it.
Download the PDF and print it for a table, counter, wall or guest room.
restaurant-menu-card-printable: Type the cafe, kitchen or shop name and add a logo. Optionally add a line under the name.
Type one item per line as Item | price | short description. Start a line with # for a section heading, such as #Starters.
Pick one or two columns, a theme colour and font, and a line at the bottom such as a note about allergies.
Download the PDF and print it, or laminate it. Long menus continue on a second page.
question-paper-template-printable: Type the school name, add a logo, then the exam name, subject, class and time allowed.
Type one question per line. Add marks like [2] at the end. For multiple choice write Question | option | option | option, and add =b to mark the answer. Start a line with # for a section heading.
Choose how many answer lines to leave under written questions, and whether to print a name and roll number line and an answer key page.
Download the PDF. The maximum marks are added up for you, and long papers continue on more pages.

signatureMakerGuide.title: Signature Maker: Draw or Type a Signature and Save It as a Transparent PNG
signatureMakerGuide.subtitle: Make a signature picture: draw with your finger or type your name, choose the ink, and download a transparent PNG for forms and documents. Free and private.
faq: What does the signature maker do?
It turns a signature you draw or type into a picture file (PNG) trimmed to the ink, with a see-through background, so you can place it on forms and documents.
Can I draw with my finger on a phone?
Yes. The drawing area is made for touch as well as a mouse. Draw slowly and use Undo to remove the last stroke.
What is the difference between a see-through and a white background?
See-through lets the paper or page show behind the ink, which suits documents. A white background suits forms that reject see-through pictures.
Is a signature picture a legal e-signature?
Not by itself. It is a plain image of your signature. Use it where an image is accepted, and follow the rules of whoever asked for the signature.
Why does my typed signature look different on another device?
Typed styles use the fonts already installed on your device, so a script style can look a little different elsewhere. Download the PNG to keep exactly what you see.
How do I put the signature on a PDF?
Download the PNG, then use the Sign PDF tool on this site, where you can draw or choose your picture and place it on any page.
Is my information uploaded or stored?
No. Everything is done in your browser on your own device, and nothing you add is sent to {{siteName}} or saved on this site. The page still loads advertising and other resources from the network.

faq: How do I sign a PDF with this tool?
Choose the PDF, draw, type or upload your signature, tap the place on the page where it should go, and download the signed PDF.
Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?
No. The PDF is opened and changed in your browser on your own device. Nothing is sent to a server.
Can I sign more than one page?
Yes. Place the signature on this page, on the last page, or on every page at the same spot.
Can I use a photo of my handwritten signature?
Yes. Choose the picture and turn on the option that makes the white paper see-through, so only the ink is placed on the page.
Is this a certified digital signature?
No. It places a picture of your signature on the page. Use it where a plain signature image is accepted; some uses need a certified or legally defined e-signature.
Why can I not open my PDF?
A PDF with a password cannot be opened until it is unlocked. Use the Unlock PDF tool first, then sign it. Very large files over 40 MB should be compressed first.

faq: How does the document scanner work?
You add photos of pages, the tool lifts shadows and whitens the paper, and you trim and turn each page. It then builds one PDF.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. Take a photo button opens the camera on most phones, and Choose pictures lets you use photos already in your gallery.
What do the looks mean?
Clean colour keeps colour and whitens paper. Clean gray removes colour. Black and white gives sharp text and small files, best for text pages.
Does it find the page edges by itself?
No. You trim each edge with a slider. Fill the frame when you photograph and lay the page flat in even light for the best result.
Does it read the text?
No. It cleans pictures and makes a PDF. To make a searchable PDF, use the Scan to Searchable PDF tool on this site.
How many pages can I scan at once?
Up to 30 pages at a time, to keep your phone responsive. Make several PDFs and join them with Merge PDF if you need more.

Can it change the background?

faq: What does the photo grid splitter do?
It cuts one picture into a grid of equal pieces, each saved as its own numbered JPG, so you can post them side by side.
How big can the grid be?
Up to 5 columns by 5 rows. Common choices are 3 by 1 for a panorama and 3 by 3 for a profile grid.
In what order should I post the pieces?
Start with number 1 and finish with the highest number. A profile shows the newest post first, so this builds the grid the right way round.

Can I keep the whole picture?

sections.heading: What the signature maker is
paragraphs: The signature maker is a small drawing pad. You sign with a finger or mouse, or type your name in a handwriting style, and it saves just the ink as a picture with a see-through background.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A saved signature picture saves you from printing, signing and scanning a page every time. Forms, letters, invoices and documents that accept an image of a signature can use the same file again and again.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Draw slowly on a large screen for the smoothest line, and keep the pen thickness moderate so the signature stays clear when it is made small. Keep the PNG somewhere safe, because anyone who has it can paste it onto a page.

sections.heading: What the sign PDF tool is
paragraphs: Sign PDF places a picture of your signature on a page of your PDF. You choose the signature, tap the spot on a preview of the page, and the tool writes the signed copy to your device.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: It saves the print, sign and scan routine for forms, agreements, declarations and letters that accept a signature image. Because the work happens in your browser, the document never leaves your phone or computer.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Choose a page preview large enough to see the signature line, and keep the size modest so the signature looks natural. Check the downloaded PDF before you send it, and keep the original unsigned copy.

sections.heading: What the document scanner is
paragraphs: The document scanner turns phone photos of paper into a clean PDF. It removes the shadow and uneven light that make photos of pages hard to read, then lets you trim, turn and order the pages.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: It is useful for forms, certificates, receipts, notes and identity proofs that you need to send as one file. The clean-up makes text darker and paper whiter, which also makes the file smaller.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Photograph each page flat, in daylight if possible, with the whole page in view. Choose Black and white for text, Clean colour for stamps and photos, and always check each page before you send an important document.

sections.heading: What the passport photo sheet maker is
paragraphs: The passport photo sheet maker crops one photo to a standard size and tiles it across the paper. It saves the cost of a studio print when you only need the layout.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A sheet of copies is handy for forms, admissions, ID cards and applications. Choosing the paper first shows how many photos fit, so you can use the whole sheet.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Use a sharp, evenly lit photo taken at eye level, and check the requirements of the office you are applying to. Print on photo paper at actual size and trim along the thin lines with a sharp cutter or scissors.

sections.heading: What the photo grid splitter is
paragraphs: The photo grid splitter turns one large picture into a set of numbered pieces. Posted together, the pieces read as one big picture across a profile grid or a swipeable carousel.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: It is handy for panoramas, posters, shop banners and big announcements. Seeing the grid lines on the preview lets you place faces and text so no line cuts through them.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Start with a sharp, high-resolution picture so each piece stays crisp. Keep important text away from the grid lines, and post in the numbered order so the grid builds correctly.

sections.heading: What the photo collage maker is
paragraphs: The photo collage maker joins several pictures into one, so you can share a whole event or a product range in a single post. You choose the layout and style, and see the result before you download.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: Collages are useful for before-and-after pictures, festival memories, product catalogues and school events. A single image is also easier to send than a long list of photos.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Choose photos with similar brightness for the cleanest look, put the best photo first, and use a little spacing so the pictures do not blend together. Pick the size that matches where you will post it.

sections.heading: What the Secret Santa generator is
paragraphs: The Secret Santa generator draws gift-exchange matches fairly on a single phone. It uses your browser's random number generator and checks that no one draws themselves or a person they should not.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: It suits offices, families, classes and friend groups who want to run a gift exchange without asking everyone to share an email. Passing one phone also makes it a fun part of the party.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Decide the budget and the date before you draw, and finish all the reveals before you close the page. If someone misses their reveal, use the organiser option or draw again and start over.

sections.heading: What the stamp maker is
paragraphs: The stamp maker draws a round or rectangular stamp from your own text. Curved text follows the circle, and the border, stars, tilt and worn ink make it look like a stamped impression.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A stamp picture is useful for marking documents Paid, Received or Approved, and for adding a shop or society name to your invoices and notices.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Keep the text short, use one ink colour, and place the stamp so it does not cover the writing underneath. Check the requirements of whoever receives the document, because some require a registered stamp.

sections.heading: What the ID cards is
paragraphs: The ID card maker lays out photo ID cards on a page, with your logo, a colour band, a box for a photo and the details of each person. You can type the people in or print blank cards.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A neat ID card helps schools, tuition centres, small businesses, societies and events show who belongs. Printing several per page keeps paper use low.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Print on thick paper or card at actual size, laminate if you can, and cut along the edge. Use a recent passport-size photo and add the valid-until date so old cards are easy to spot.

sections.heading: What the UPI QR stand is
paragraphs: The UPI QR stand makes a printable Scan and Pay sign for your shop counter. You type your UPI ID and shop name, add a logo, and the page draws the QR code as sharp vector squares.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A clear sign speeds up payments and means fewer customers asking for your number. Showing the name beside the code also helps customers confirm they are paying the right shop.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Always scan the printed code with your own app before you put it up. Use dark ink on white paper, keep the code unfolded and unscratched, and replace the sign if your UPI ID changes.

sections.heading: What the Wi-Fi sign is
paragraphs: The Wi-Fi password sign puts your network name, password and a joining QR code on one printable page. Guests scan the code and connect without typing a long password.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: It suits cafes, waiting rooms, offices, classrooms, homestays and guest rooms, and it cuts down on repeated questions about the password.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Use a separate guest network for public places and change the password from time to time. Test the QR code with your own phone before you print and display the sign.

sections.heading: What the menu card is
paragraphs: The menu card maker turns a list of items into a tidy printed menu. Section headings, prices and dotted lines to the price give it a clean restaurant look without a design tool.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: A printed menu or price list helps small cafes, home kitchens, bakeries, salons and shops. It saves explaining the same things over and over and makes prices clear to customers.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Keep descriptions short, group items into sections, and use two columns for long menus. Print a copy first, check the prices, and update the sheet whenever prices change.

sections.heading: What the question paper is
paragraphs: The question paper template lays out a test paper from the questions you type. It adds the school header, the exam details, name and roll lines, numbered questions with marks and space for answers.
It runs in your browser, and nothing you add is uploaded.

sections.heading: Why it helps
paragraphs: Teachers and tuition tutors save time because the layout, numbering and marks total are done for them. Multiple choice questions are lettered automatically and an answer key page keeps the answers separate from the paper.

sections.heading: Using it well
paragraphs: Write each question clearly, give marks in brackets, and group questions into sections. Print one copy and check it before running off the class set, and keep the answer key page apart from the student copies.
